title: Boundary identity for the Lipschitz cut-off γ_{a,b}∘f from weak limits of tangential derivatives (proof of Simon Ch. 6, 4.5(2), steps (1)–(4))
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and T ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (n+1)). Suppose T is represented by the integer multiplicity triple RT = (M, θ, ξ) in U of dimension n+1, and ∂T by the triple RB = (M', θ', ξ') in U of dimension n:
 T(η) = ∫_M θ⟨η, ξ⟩ dH^{n+1} for η ∈ 𝒟^{n+1}(U), and ∂T(ω) = T(dω) = ∫_{M'} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dHⁿ for ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U).
Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz, and g : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Borel with |g| ≤ L. Write T_xM := approxTangentPlane (n+1) M x and γ_{a,b}(s) := min{1, max{0, (b − s)/(b − a)}}. Assume the weak-limit property (G5):
 for all a < b, every sequence (h_k) of C¹ functions ℝ^P → ℝ with ‖Dh_k‖ ≤ c converging uniformly on ℝ^P to γ_{a,b}∘f, and every Borel W : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with |W| ≤ c', W = 0 outside some compact K ⊆ U, and W(x) ∈ T_xM for H^{n+1}-a.e. x ∈ M, we have ∫_M θ Dh_k[W] dH^{n+1} → ∫_{M∩{a<f<b}} θ·(−(b − a)⁻¹⟨g, W⟩) dH^{n+1}.
Then for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) and all real a < b:
 ∫_{M'} θ'·γ_{a,b}(f)·⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dHⁿ = ∫_M θ·γ_{a,b}(f)·⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{n+1} − (b − a)⁻¹ ∫_{M∩{a<f<b}} θ·⟨g♭ ∧ ω, ξ⟩ dH^{n+1}.
Here dω = exteriorDerivative ω, ⟨α, ζ⟩ = ζ(α), Hᵏ = μHE[k], and g♭ ∧ ω := alternatizeUncurryFin((innerSL ℝ g(x)).smulRight ω(x)); all integrals are Bochner integrals.
